data_table.description: Sample ID, time in fixative, analyte type, tissue bank [tumor tissue and surrounding normal tissue], % of necrosis in sample, body site where sample was obtained, diagnostic pathology report, % of tumor tissue in sample, time the tissue sample was frozen in liquid nitrogen, fixation time, diagnosis of resected tissue, surgical tissue collection and preservation procedure, disease was observed in resected tissue, dimensions of tissue, histologic grade, histological type, tumor status of sample, % of necrosis in tumor sample, method of freezing, non-cellular component in sample, organ of origin of tumor sample, pathologic spread of distant metastases, pathologic spread of lymph nodes, tumor stage, pathologic spread of primary tumor, % of non-cellular component in sample, number of tumor epithelial cell nuclei as compared to all cell nuclei, experimental protocol, weight of resection, dimensions of resection, presence of sarcomatoid features, tissue processor cycle completion and embedding, histologic profile of sample, surgical tissue collection and preservation, tumor dimension, and weight of frozen tumor block of participants with different type of cancer and involved in the "National Cancer Institute (NCI) Biospecimen Pre-analytical Variables (BPV) Analysis" project.
